**Step Title: Add one new feature to Model A that is the square of an existing feature: effect on (Model Bias)**2**

**Hint 1:** Consider how adding a new feature that is a transformation of an existing feature might affect the model's ability to capture the true relationship between the features and the target variable. Think about whether this transformation could help the model better fit the underlying data-generating process.

**Hint 2:** Recall that bias in a model refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Adding a new feature that is a non-linear transformation of an existing feature could potentially allow the model to better capture non-linear relationships, thereby reducing bias.
